entries.summary: A supervised Pre on Windows counted cold start inside the 5 second deadline, so a clean git switch was denied at the admission checkpoint.
entries.source: CHANGELOG Unreleased, Fixed. test/supervisor.test.ts names Windows CI run 44400647892.
entries.test: time before admission does not consume the pre budget

entries.summary: Extending the Pre deadline so cold start is not charged must not let a hang after the admission checkpoint run past 5 seconds.
entries.test: a hang after admission is still cut 5 s after that checkpoint

entries.summary: pregate doctor did not say that Claude Code below 2.1.295 ignores onFailure, so a PreToolUse crash or timeout fails open on those versions.
entries.test: Claude Code below 2.1.295 warns that onFailure block is ignored

entries.summary: A Grok PreToolUse hook that crashed or timed out inside an enabled project had to deny the tool. Grok 1.0.70 ignores the field and stays fail-open.
entries.test: the recorded Grok failClosed measurement is the real 1.0.77 and 1.0.70 run (#45)

entries.summary: When a supervised engine passed its deadline, the deny could return while that process was still alive.
entries.test: a timed-out engine is dead before the deny returns

entries.summary: writeAtomic left its temporary file beside the destination when the replace failed.
entries.test: a failed atomic write removes the temporary file

entries.summary: Setting PREGATE_UNATTENDED_APPROVAL, PREGATE_TESTING, PREGATE_TEST_ANSWER, or PREGATE_ACCEPT_CONTRACT on a command was reported as a hook switch. The cause is approval.
entries.test: approval-forging variables stay denied and are not a hook switch

entries.summary: A literal git config read, including git config --get core.hooksPath, was denied as shell-admin.
entries.test: the codex pre hook allows read-only git config queries
